newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING SAYS LOSSES ON SPORT7 MINIMAL.
newsitem.headline: ING SAYS LOSSES ON SPORT7 MINIMAL.

text.p: ING Groep NV (ING) said losses from the collapse of Dutch television channel Sport7 were minimal but its stake in mobile phone operator Libertel should be a good profit contributor in future.
ING had an unspecified stake in Sport7, the sports-only channel which collapsed after only four months operation in December with losses of at least 100 million guilders.

ING executive board chairman Aad Jacobs said losses on the investment, the size of which he did not specify, would be a "minimal amount of money". "Sometimes you have a disappointment," he said in an interview.
But he said Libertel, the second digital mobile phone operator in the Netherlands, was "doing much better than the market". ING has a 52 percent shareholding.
"This year the influence on the bottom line will be low but in the coming period we are optimistic it will give a good contribution.
Other shareholders include Vodafone Plc with 35 percent and retailer Vendex with five percent.
